sections.heading: What you get for free

The limits are about volume and quality, not branding: {plan.free.monthlyMinutes} minutes of video a month, videos up to {plan.free.maxVideoMinutes} minutes, and {plan.free.maxResolution} exports.

Upgrading never adds or removes a watermark, because there isn't one to remove.

faq.question: Is there really no watermark on the free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Free exports have no logo, badge or end screen. No plan adds a watermark.

faq.question: Do I need a card to start?
faq.answer: No. Create an account and start on the free plan. You only enter payment details if you upgrade.

faq.question: What happens when I use my free minutes?
faq.answer: Your projects stay. New videos need minutes left, so they wait until your minutes renew next month, or until you switch plans.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: Dozens. Supertitle detects the spoken language automatically and writes the captions in that language.
